RORK — IVX IA CHAT INTELLIGENCE QA — BLOCK 1/3

Test the REAL IVX IA Chat production conversation interface.

This is a conversational intelligence test, NOT primarily a code test.
Do not simulate execution or fabricate evidence.

Run:
- 20 unseen general reasoning questions
- 10 unfamiliar business-analysis questions
- 10 senior software-development questions
- follow-up-question tests
- root-cause reasoning tests
- decision-making tests

Evaluate whether IVX:
- reasons instead of giving generic filler
- separates facts from assumptions
- identifies missing information
- prioritizes important issues
- explains tradeoffs
- recommends actions
- asks clarification only when materially necessary
- challenges incorrect premises
- never pretends to inspect production/code/logs unless actually inspected

For technical answers verify IVX distinguishes:
KNOWN
LIKELY
UNKNOWN
NEEDS VERIFICATION

At least 50% of questions must be newly generated blind questions.

Preserve exact prompts and exact IVX responses.

Save results/transcripts for Block 3 scoring.

Do NOT issue final PASS/FAIL yet.

STOP AFTER BLOCK 1.
